method: Direct visual inspection of all three generated PNG figures in the image viewer.
checks: Titles,axes,legends and labels legible without overlap or clipping.
Zoomed likelihood uses the same limits across panels; every point below view marked and counts shown.
Full-range plot retains both extreme density-floor scores as crosses.
Nonfinite fits and imprecise scores explicitly counted; finite does not imply a good fit.
Runtime labels distinguish per-arm total prefix costs and actual allocation with shared prefixes counted once.
